paths.title: Animus Predator
paths.description: Expose weaknesses where your enemies seem to have none, letting allies strike through ghostly bodies and pierce elemental defenses. Your spirit attacks interrupt regeneration, while an action point or a well-placed strike leaves a foe vulnerable to extra damage. You can also borrow an enemy's resistances for nearby allies and make a wounded foe suffer whenever it lands a blow against them.

paths.title: Disciple of Winds
paths.description: Keep your companions moving with helpful gusts, sliding them as you heal and helping them recover their footing after enemies push them around. An action point lets nearby allies slip into better positions, while protective winds carry one companion away from approaching foes. Your attacks open routes through enemy spaces or unleash a hurricane that scatters and dazes the opposition.

paths.title: Ghost Panther
paths.description: Stalk the battlefield with a hunter's stealth and agility, sharing concealment of your approach with allies gathered around your spirit companion. An action point exposes nearby enemies to combat advantage, and your spirit can sap the strength of bloodied prey. Sudden leaps help you escape attacks, while a gathering of panther spirits lets your whole company teleport into striking distance.

paths.title: Great Bear Shaman
paths.description: Make your spirit companion a rallying point for warriors, strengthening attacks against marked enemies and helping allies punish foes that drop their guard. Spending an action point gives a companion a melee attack, and a commanding roar lets the party reposition. Your spirit's heaviest blows mark enemies, knock them down for attacking, or leave them suffering retaliation whenever they hit.

paths.title: Great Elder
paths.description: Let your spirit companion grow into a larger guardian, extending its reach and sheltering more allies around its presence. Your attacks and action points reinforce nearby companions' defenses, while your own resolve can protect them from attacks against Will. A hymn of nature offers another burst of protection, and your greatest evocation forces nearby enemies to choose between hesitation and psychic pain.

paths.title: Keen Eagle
paths.description: Use your spirit companion's vantage point to guide ranged and area attacks around obstacles, eventually reaching enemies from much farther away. Spending an action point briefly brings a second companion into the fight, spreading your spirit's influence across two positions. Your eagle guides allies' shots and exposes enemies to critical hits, turning a carefully chosen target into an opening for the whole party.

paths.title: Phrenic Master
paths.description: Bend enemy minds through a spirit companion that projects your powers from its own position. Psychic assaults daze and move foes, while your strongest binding can dominate a victim and drag it along with the spirit. An action point makes your attack's lingering effects harder to shake off, and enemies that destroy your companion are dazed in return. You can also interpose it against an incoming blow.

paths.title: Scion of Renewal
paths.description: Turn your spirit companion into a source of recovery, strengthening Healing Spirit and giving its target the option to seek relief from a lingering affliction instead of healing. Your action points restore nearby allies, and second wind becomes an opportunity to return to the attack. Cleansing waves and a movable sanctuary help companions recover, resist disease, and shake off effects that saving throws can end.

paths.title: Seasons' Herald
paths.description: Read the battle's omens to help your company act sooner and put an extra action into the hands of the ally who needs it most. When one companion falls, another receives healing, and your spirit can answer an enemy's blow with damage equal to what it inflicted. You can carry a useful die result into your next roll or call on winter to frustrate a foe's saving throws.

paths.title: Soul Igniter
paths.description: Feed your companions' momentum with soulfire, turning critical hits into greater speed, sharper reflexes, and extra fire damage on their attacks. Spending an action point spreads that power to several companions at once. Your evocations scorch groups of enemies, and empowered allies can become moving sources of heat that burn nearby foes. Even destroying your spirit companion can unleash a final burst of flame.

paths.title: Stormcaller
paths.description: Gather lightning, rain, and wind around your spirit companion, punishing enemies that attack it and dazing those that destroy it. Your action points help the company reposition, while storm spirits lend lightning damage to allied attacks and protect nearby companions from lightning and thunder. Driving rain conceals allies and exposes enemies to the storm, and a powerful cyclone knocks foes down while opening paths for your companions.

paths.title: Voice for the Ravaged
paths.description: Give wounded primal spirits a voice, turning their anger into elemental protection for an ally and vengeance against your enemies. Your daily attacks bolster nearby companions and let them reposition, while a restorative wind heals and shields the group. Psychic commands force foes to strike one another, and your greatest outcry can stun a crowd before drawing the most vulnerable minds under your control.
